provenance.notes: Proprietary DAW distributed free of charge by Cockos under its own EULA. Opt-in only; HorneroOS ships no license and grants no usage rights beyond the vendor's terms.
Windows VST compatibility layer. Requires Wine and Windows plugins the user has legally obtained; HorneroOS supplies neither Wine configuration nor any plugin.

options.name: HorneroOS Gaming — Hyprland
options.description: Gaming desktop based on HorneroOS Desktop, with Gamescope, GameMode and MangoHud; launchers are explicit opt-ins. Compositor: Hyprland. Preview support.

steam-devices.notes: Controller and VR device udev rules shipped with Steam; harmless without Steam installed and required for controller discovery.

gamemode.notes: Feral Interactive GameMode daemon. Process-scoped and temporary; HorneroOS never enables it globally or persists its tweaks.

gamescope.notes: Valve Gamescope micro-compositor, available as a tool and as the handheld Gaming Session compositor. Never forced around every game; session use is hardware-qualified per device.

mangohud.notes: Diagnostics and measurement overlay only; not a tuning tool.
